def write_parallel_event(path):
    Journal(Path(path)).event("parallel", {})


def apply_template_body(request):
    prompt = json.dumps({"messages": request.get("messages", []), "tools": request.get("tools", []), "add_generation_prompt": request.get("add_generation_prompt")}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    return json.dumps({"prompt": prompt}, ensure_ascii=False)


def evidence_descriptor(path):
    raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
    return {"artifact_ref": str(Path(path).resolve()), "artifact_sha256": __import__("hashlib").sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "size_bytes": len(raw)}


def complete_read_record(agent, path, call_id):
    arguments = {"path": str(Path(path).resolve()), "offset": 0, "limit": 12000}
    pending = {"id": call_id, "name": "read_file", "arguments": arguments}
    agent.state["pending_tool_calls"].append(pending)
    agent._complete_tool(pending, agent.dispatch("read_file", arguments))
    return agent.state["result_packages"][-1]


def complete_alias_required_reads(agent, call_prefix):
    completed = []
    while agent.state.get("execution_phase") == "NEED_REQUIRED_READ":
        call = agent._required_read_next_call()
        arguments = {key: call[key] for key in ("filePath", "offset", "limit")}
        pending = {"id": f"{call_prefix}-{len(completed)}", "name": "read", "arguments": arguments}
        agent.state["pending_tool_calls"].append(pending)
        agent._complete_tool(pending, agent.dispatch("read", arguments))
        completed.append(agent.state["result_packages"][-1])
    return completed

    def test_subagent_send_sigusr1_cancels_headers_and_next_request_has_message(self):
        first_started = threading.Event(); release_first = threading.Event(); second_seen = threading.Event(); requests = []
        class BlockingHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def do_POST(self):
                length = int(self.headers["Content-Length"]); request = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length))
                if self.path == "/apply-template":
                    body = apply_template_body(request).encode(); self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body); return
                if self.path == "/tokenize":
                    content = request.get("content", ""); body = json.dumps({"tokens": list(range(max(1, len(content.encode("utf-8")) // 4)))})
                    self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body.encode()))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body.encode()); return
                requests.append(request)
                if len(requests) == 1:
                    first_started.set(); release_first.wait(3)
                else:
                    second_seen.set()
                args = {"status": "completed", "summary": "continued"}
                body = json.dumps({"choices": [{"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": None, "tool_calls": [{"id": "finish", "type": "function", "function": {"name": "finish_task", "arguments": json.dumps(args)}}]}}]}).encode()
                try:
                    self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
                except OSError:
                    pass
            def log_message(self, *_): pass
        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), BlockingHandler); thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True); thread.start()
        subagent_process = None
        try:
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
                state = Path(td) / "subagent-process"; caller = EchoAgent(root=Path(td) / "caller", role="caller"); caller.set_task("caller")
                subagent_process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "tools/echo_ajan.py", "--server", f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}", "--state", str(state), "--caller-task-id", caller.state["session_id"], "--subagent-id", "subagent-process", "--subagent-role", "subagent", "--task", "continue"], stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, start_new_session=True)
                self.assertTrue(first_started.wait(5))
                caller.state["subagents"]["subagent-process"] = {"task_id": "subagent-process", "state": str(state), "pid": subagent_process.pid, "role": "implementer"}
                started = time.monotonic(); caller._subagent_send("subagent-process", "user interruption")
                release_first.set()
                self.assertTrue(second_seen.wait(1), "SIGUSR1 did not reach a second request within one second")
                self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 1.0)
                self.assertIn("user interruption", json.dumps(requests[1], ensure_ascii=False))
                subagent_process.communicate(timeout=5)
        finally:
            release_first.set()
            if subagent_process is not None and subagent_process.poll() is None:
                subagent_process.terminate()
                try:
                    subagent_process.communicate(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    subagent_process.kill(); subagent_process.communicate(timeout=5)
            if subagent_process is not None and subagent_process.stderr is not None and not subagent_process.stderr.closed:
                subagent_process.stderr.close()
            server.shutdown(); server.server_close(); thread.join()
